content: Letter 46, to Khwāja Ẓahīr al-Dīn Muḥammad (MK: perhaps the copyist of MS Majlis 10196): a letter of friendship. Ibn Turka opens by praying against the wiles of the envious and hostile and invoking the spiritual support of Sufis, regrets that their families had lost touch and is glad the old bond is renewed, and wishes to re-establish contact with other possible relations, especially Khwāja Burhān al-Dīn Yaqīn, from whom he is currently estranged (TMN/M f. 188b, TMN/MS pp. 33-34, TMN/D pp. 216-17).
